focus.title: 美国商务部拟将多项AI芯片纳入对华出口管制新规，企业需提前合规评估
focus.summary: 据多方消息，美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）预计在近期发布新规，进一步收紧对华高端人工智能芯片及制造设备的出口许可，涉及先进制程芯片、HBM存储及特定EDA工具。新规或扩大“最终用户”审查范围，并增加对第三国转口的限制。建议相关企业立即梳理供应链与客户清单，评估受影响产品，并准备替代方案或申请许可的合规材料。
focus.source: 来源：综合路透社、彭博社报道 · 2026.08.17
focus.title_en: U.S. Commerce Dept. Expected to Tighten Export Controls on AI Chips to China; Enterprises Urged to Conduct Early Compliance Review
focus.summary_en: According to multiple sources, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) is expected to issue new rules soon to further tighten export licensing for advanced AI chips, HBM memory, and certain EDA tools to China. The rules may expand end-user review and restrict transshipment via third countries. Companies are advised to promptly map their supply chains and customer lists, assess affected products, and prepare compliance materials for alternatives or license applications.
focus.source_en: Source: Based on reports from Reuters and Bloomberg · 2026.08.17

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁决：跨境服务合同中的“不竞争条款”适用中国法，获法院承认与执行
case.summary: 近期，新加坡高等法院承认并执行了SIAC一项涉华仲裁裁决。该案中，一家中国科技公司与新加坡合作方签订服务合同，约定不竞争条款适用中国法。仲裁庭认定，该条款不违反中国《反不正当竞争法》，并裁决中方胜诉。新加坡法院认为仲裁庭对法律适用的判断合理，予以承认。此案提示中国企业在跨境合同中明确法律适用条款，并确保条款内容符合相关法域强制性规定，以降低裁决被拒绝执行的风险。
case.source: 来源：新加坡高等法院判决摘要（2026年7月）
case.title_en: SIAC Award on Non-Compete Clause Governed by PRC Law Recognized and Enforced by Singapore High Court
case.summary_en: The Singapore High Court recently recognized and enforced an SIAC arbitral award involving a Chinese tech company and a Singapore partner. The contract stipulated that the non-compete clause would be governed by PRC law. The tribunal found the clause not in violation of China's Anti-Unfair Competition Law. The Singapore court upheld the tribunal's legal reasoning. This case highlights the importance for Chinese companies to clearly specify governing law in cross-border contracts and ensure compliance with mandatory rules to reduce risks of non-enforcement.
case.source_en: Source: Summary of Singapore High Court judgment (July 2026)

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境数据流动新规落地：企业需建立数据出境安全评估与备案机制
policy.summary: 广东省互联网信息办公室近期发布《粤港澳大湾区数据跨境流动安全管理规范（试行）》，明确在大湾区内地九市与香港、澳门之间，重要数据和个人信息出境需进行安全评估或标准合同备案。新规简化了部分低风险场景的流程，但强化了企业主体责任。建议相关企业立即梳理数据资产，识别重要数据目录，并建立内部数据出境合规流程，以免违规风险。
policy.source: 来源：广东省互联网信息办公室 · 2026年8月
policy.title_en: New Cross-Border Data Flow Rules in Greater Bay Area: Enterprises Must Establish Security Assessment and Filing Mechanisms
policy.summary_en: The Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province recently issued the 'Administrative Norms for Cross-Border Data Flow Security in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (Trial)', requiring security assessments or standard contract filings for important data and personal information transfers between the nine mainland cities in the GBA and Hong Kong/Macau. The rules simplify procedures for certain low-risk scenarios but strengthen enterprise obligations. Companies are advised to inventory data assets, identify important data catalogs, and establish internal compliance processes to avoid violations.
policy.source_en: Source: Cyberspace Administration of Guangdong Province · August 2026

analysis.title: 欧盟《外国补贴条例》执法趋严：中国企业应提前布局反补贴合规体系
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：欧盟《外国补贴条例》已进入全面实施阶段，近期多起针对中国企业的调查显示，欧委会将重点审查公共补贴对并购和公共采购的影响。建议出海企业：（1）建立补贴台账，记录所有来自中国政府的财政支持；（2）在交易前进行补贴申报评估，主动披露以避免高额罚款；（3）针对欧委会调查，准备抗辩材料，证明补贴不影响市场公平竞争。合规成本远低于被处罚的风险。
analysis.source: 来源：秦林蒿律师团队分析 · 2026.08.17
analysis.title_en: EU's Foreign Subsidies Regulation Enforcement Intensifies: Chinese Companies Should Build Anti-Subsidy Compliance Systems in Advance
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The EU Foreign Subsidies Regulation is now in full force, and recent investigations into Chinese firms show the Commission will scrutinize the impact of public subsidies on M&A and public procurement. Recommendations: (1) Maintain a subsidy ledger documenting all financial support from Chinese government; (2) Conduct pre-transaction subsidy filing assessments and proactively disclose to avoid heavy fines; (3) Prepare defense materials to prove subsidies do not distort competition. Compliance costs are far lower than the risk of penalties.
analysis.source_en: Source: Attorney Qin Linhao's Team Analysis · 2026.08.17
